sections.heading: What is trending: “harry & meghan”
paragraphs: “harry & meghan” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for HU (snapshot taken 2026-09-15T15:01:04+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from HELLO! Magazine, People.com, The Telegraph. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Prince Harry and Meghan Markle switch Archie and Lilibet's school just days after term begins” — HELLO! Magazine
“Harry and Meghan move children to new school over security concerns” — The Telegraph

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 15 Sep 2026 02:50:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-15T15:01:04+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-15T15:01:10+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
